articles.headline: No. 8 Arizona tops Colorado State 96-83 with all 5 starters reaching double figures in Maui
articles.description: — Ivan Kharchenkov scored 24 points and Caleb Holt had 20 for No. 8 Arizona in a 96-83 win over Colorado State on the first day of the Maui Invitational on Monday night.

articles.description: — Mekhi Mason scored a career-high 31 points to lead San Jose State to a 88-79 victory over UC San Diego on Monday night in the third-place game of the Acrisure Series.

article.headline: New Hampshire wins 90-70 against Stonehill
article.description: — Ryan Zan’s 18 points helped New Hampshire defeat Stonehill 90-70 on Wednesday.
article.story: NORTH EASTON, Mass. -- — Ryan Zan’s 18 points helped New Hampshire defeat Stonehill 90-70 on Wednesday. Zan also contributed 11 rebounds for the Wildcats (4-2). Erik Oliver-Bush scored 16 points while going 5 of 8 and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line. John Squire shot 4 of 5 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line to finish with 13 points. Devon Arlington led the way for the Skyhawks (1-4) with 13 points. Stonehill also got 13 points from Eli Greenberg. Anquan Boldin Jr. finished with 10 points and four steals. Up next Both teams play again on Saturday. New Hampshire visits New Haven and Stonehill hosts Northeastern. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
